`legacy.doc` contains the synthetic sentence `Legacy document facts.` followed
by 20 ordinary synthetic paragraphs, long enough for antiword's legacy text stream.
It was generated from UTF-8 plain text with LibreOffice Writer's `MS Word 97`
export filter on the isolated Ubuntu 24.04 qualification host. It contains no
third-party document content or macro. The Linux test runs the real antiword
executable shipped in the Worker image; no fake converter is used.
